preconditions.description: The input must be provided via standard input.
The number of nodes in the binary tree must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= node.data <= 10**5 for node in nodes)
preconditions.description: The data of each node must be between 0 and 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output must consist of the level order traversal followed by the inorder traversal of the connected tree.

postconditions.expression: all(node.nextRight is not None for node in nodes)
postconditions.description: All nodes must have their nextRight pointers set to the next node at the same level.
